title: Nice Glassware for the Toaster Oven, but of Limited Use
text:
Nice Glassware for the Toaster Oven, but of Limited Use. Note: There is more than one product attached to this listing. I am specifically writing this review for the 6-piece set.

I have a nice toaster oven and I have on occasion wished I could use it more efficiently as an oven instead of just a toaster and broiler. These actually fit my toaster oven nicely and will see more use. That said, there are some limitations.

As another reviewer stated, these are not borosilicate glass, but rather are coke lime glass. That's usually not a problem, but it does mean the heat tolerances are lower than older Pyrex glassware. Most significantly it means these are not safe to go directly from the freezer to the oven. Using them that way can result in shatterrd glass and a big mess to clean up.

These are smaller, low-profile glass dishes that fit nicely in a toaster oven. They're unusual sizes though, and I have found very few recipes that call for these smaller sizes of dishes. They're perhaps useful for breaking recipes into two dishes but then you'll have to play with the bake times. Keep this in mind. On the other hand, these are useful when making smaller batches of roasted vegetables and similar things, where a recipe isn't followed and the quantity is kept small.

Being glass, these are not hard to clean when you have finished with them. They are dishwasher safe, and it is safe to put some muscle behind them when scrubbing when there's something stubborn stuck on them. They do not stack particularly well, but even so they're small enough to tuck away in less convenient places on shelves and cabinets that are too small for bigger dishes.

I do like these, and I do make use of them, but I can see limited usefulness because of the small and unusual sizes. Typical recipes need to be scaled and cook times adjusted to make these work.
